boardChanges.before: Status: the scale amendment is drafted, not ratified; Zorg's new reply answers connection ownership and proposes lifecycle and egress mechanisms for review.\

boardChanges.before: | `B51` | Define reply isolation at the actual egress boundary | [Zorg's new reply](VERIFICATION.md#new-zorg-correspondence) withdraws the current confidentiality claim and prefers optional exact-peer egress; review proof, replacement-session ownership and trusted-relay scope while preserving D26 for generic sends; server push is deferred |
boardChanges.after: | `B51` | Agree direct-only reply scope and the principal-association boundary | [Advisory review](reviews/reply-isolation-review.md) requires reconciliation of Zorg's relay clause and either a proved stable node-to-principal admission invariant or an explicit immutable association; shared send enforcement and consumer adoption remain unbuilt, and server push is deferred |

boardChanges.before: | Which scoped mechanism enforces the same-node and proved-principal reply policy, and when, if ever, may a trusted relay carry it? | `B51` reply isolation; the proposed option is not adopted, and generic D26 multi-hop pin semantics remain unchanged |
boardChanges.after: | Do we agree direct-only reply egress and its principal-association contract before choosing public types? | `B51` design selection; [review](reviews/reply-isolation-review.md) recommends excluding AGP relays from this guarantee and agreeing the admission invariant or immutable association with Zorg; ordinary D26 behavior remains unchanged |
